title: Polynomial time of initial configuration encoding
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $s$ assign a natural number to each Boolean string. If the function sending each string $x$ to the string of $s(x)$ true bits is computable in polynomial time, then the function sending $x$ to the configuration code of the initial configuration of $M$ on input $x$, using parameters $n=|x|$ and space bound $s(x)$, is computable in polynomial time.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$s$ maps Boolean strings to natural numbers
the function $x\mapsto$ the string of $s(x)$ true bits is polynomial-time computable
